label: early original-phase y/s/j input after o/d/u/f/p/0 prefix
predicate: (phase == 0) & (t >= 2) & (t <= 5) & isin(in_tok, [tok("y"), tok("s"), tok("j")]) & seen([tok("o"), tok("d"), tok("u"), tok("f"), tok("p"), tok("0")])
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, almost entirely at steps t=2..5 (t=3 peak, 45% of mass). Never fires at t=0, on the delimiter, or during copy (1 activation). Input-token selective: y (12x lift, 46% of mass, and all of the top activations), then s (24%), j (10%), weaker on g/e/r. Mostly first occurrences of the token (94% of mass). Stronger when the preceding prefix has o/d/u/f/p/0 (first_tok o/d/u lift 3-4x). The predicate (y/s/j at t 2-5 after one of those prefix tokens) gets about 0.42 F1 and 0.65 mass recall on dev. Many y/s steps with other prefixes stay silent, and weak activations on other letters (g, e, k, b, r) are missed, so the prefix dependence is only roughly captured.
